run_train_nonstationary_gp: run the train function to fit a NonstationaryGpModule model using PyTorch Lightning
run_train_from_checkpoint: run the train function to resume training a NonstationaryGpModule from a saved checkpoint path
review_train_function: review the train function setup including batch size, checkpoint callback, and trainer configuration
refactor_train_config: refactor the train function to load hyperparameters from a config file instead of hardcoded values
test_train_with_batch_size: test the train function with a specified batch size and optional model checkpoint path
